facts.text: I have been buying a lot of stuff online lately.
I have made at least 10 online purchases in the past month.
Most of my online purchases have been from Amazon.
I tend to buy things on impulse.
I buy things on impulse especially on weekends when I am bored.
I want to unsubscribe from promotional emails.
I want to declutter my email inbox and make it more organized.
I want to set up filters for my online shopping emails, including Amazon and Sephora.
I want to organize my online shopping emails into one place.
I want to set up a filter for my grocery shopping emails from Walmart.
I have been using Walmart's grocery pickup service a lot lately.
